Food

What comes to the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Mix grill

The mix grill for two or more is the favourite. Guests praise the soft, not at all dry chicken and the lamb.

Shish tawouk and souvlaki

Shish tawouk on the plate or in a sandwich, souvlaki and kebab, blending Middle Eastern and Cypriot cooking.

Meze and vegan dishes

Falafel, tabbouleh, fattoush, baba ghanoush, muhammara and hummus. Guests mention many vegetarian and vegan options.

Mahalabia

For dessert, the milk pudding that guests call a true revelation.

From the grill

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Like visiting friends

The owners work there themselves. Guests describe a warm welcome, like visiting friends rather than a restaurant.

Fair prices

Large portions at reasonable prices, many guests write. 6 reviews mention the large portions.

Outside and at home

Tables outside on the terrace, or takeaway and delivery for the whole family.

On Tseriou Avenue

At Leoforos Tseriou 268 in Strovolos. Open every day except Tuesday from 11:00 to 23:00.

What guests say

Three of 210 Google reviews, 193 of them with five stars.

“For me, the best establishment in Nicosia for a nice grill meal. It blends Middle Eastern and Cypriot cuisine. The dishes are seasoned to perfection and they’re flavourful beyond belief. Perfect option for delivery with the family.”

Google review
“Very pleasantly surprised. The best Arabic food on the island. Clean, tasty, and perfectly cooked, yet with affordable prices. I highly recommend and I will become a frequent customer.”

Google review
“Excellent food, full of flavour. Stopped there for lunch and returned another day for dinner whilst on holiday from England - it was that good. Definitely worth a visit.”
